text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day in the library, I saw Hishi Amazon and Sakura Chitose O spreading out their study materials on a desk.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
You're a lifesaver, Chitose O! 
With you by my side, maybe I can actually get through these exams.
choice_data_list: Are you two studying for your exams?
Are you two about to study for exams?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Yeah. I've got a classical Chinese test coming up, but whenever I read the textbook, it's all Greek to me.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chitose O
text_block_list.text: Sending charcoal in snow—with a spirit of mutual aid, let us overcome this trial together...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Past, person... Is this how you read "ancient times"? 
And then... Zhuang, Zhou, dream... become?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chitose O
text_block_list.text:
There are reverse reading marks, so the order shifts... 
It reads, "Once upon a time, Zhuang Zhou dreamed he was a butterfly"—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Guhhh... 
Going back and forth all over the place, it's just so confusing...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Gwaaaaaahhh!! 
N-No good! I don't get this at aaalll!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: It's already tough enough being wall-to-wall kanji, and there's too much to keep track of... I've hit my limit!!
choice_data_list: Still, if it's an exam, you've got to do your best.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I know, I don't plan on giving up! 
But no matter how much I read, nothing sticks in my head...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chitose O
text_block_list.text:
In that case, let us attempt a different approach—
Finding a method of learning tailored to you is an urgent matter.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
My way of doing things, huh? 
If only a one-on-one duel worked, I could fight any opponent out there.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
When the opponent is classical Chinese, I'm completely helpless...! 
I can't even make heads or tails of what's written!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chitose O
text_block_list.text:
Then, perhaps—learning classical Chinese through a one-on-one duel might be a worthwhile measure. 
If you do not mind, I shall gladly be your opponent—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
A one-on-one with you...? 
I'd love that, but how?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chitose O
text_block_list.text:
Hohoho... 
A contest where hearts connect and souls clash. 
Let us put it to the test—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Hah, where on earth are we...? 
How are we supposed to study in a place like this?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chitose O
text_block_list.text:
There is no need for overthinking. 
With your body, with your technique—
challenge me, and feel the truth for yourself...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I see, think about it later, huh... 
If that's how it is—now that I can understand!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chitose O
text_block_list.text:
Hohoho—a splendid technique. 
However, you must not expect to settle everything with a single blow...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chitose O
text_block_list.text:
"If another succeeds with one effort, strive a hundredfold." 
—Now, strike once more.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Kgh, still not reaching... 
But I feel something clicking...!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: ...I get it. By repeating it over and over, my technique is getting sharper...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chitose O
text_block_list.text:
Hohoho... It seems you have realized. 
The true meaning of those words—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chitose O
text_block_list.text:
Even if others achieve it in a single try, the resolve to practice a hundred times, unyielding effort—
that is indeed your path.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I get it now, so that's what that classical text meant...! 
I'm starting to understand what you're saying!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Chitose O, teach me more!! 
Show me the soul behind the other passages through this duel!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chitose O
text_block_list.text:
Hohoho, very well. 
I shall raise the difficulty, so prepare yourself—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Phew—I finally get it. 
My own personal way to decipher classical Chinese...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chitose O
text_block_list.text:
The fog of confusion has cleared, and your spirit is serene... 
Hohoho... Splendid, truly splendid.
choice_data_list: You found yourself a wonderful teacher.
You met a wonderful teacher, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chitose O
text_block_list.text:
The fog of confusion has cleared, and your spirit is serene... 
Hohoho... Splendid, truly splendid.
choice_data_list: You found yourself a wonderful teacher.
You met a wonderful teacher, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
You're right. 
Everything she taught me in this duel, I won't let a bit of it go to waste!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: After that, Hishi Amazon devoted herself to studying via the duel method, successfully avoiding failing marks.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Looks like the heat of our duel got through to you too. 
Well, how about it? Pretty addicting, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Afterward, the "One-on-One Study Method" advocated by Hishi Amazon became quite popular and spread among a portion of the students...
